title: Twilio Voice Insights Call Summary drops attributes.conference_participant on 2026-08-01
summary: On August 1, 2026 Twilio removed the conference_participant attribute from the Voice Insights Call Summary (GET /v1/Voice/{CallSid}/Summary on insights.twilio.com) and the matching Event Streams event; attributes now returns null for every call. Code that reads attributes.conference_participant gets nothing, and code that dereferences attributes can throw.
migrationNote: Stop reading attributes.conference_participant and treat attributes as nullable. Get conference data from the Conference Insights API or Conference Insights Event Streams instead.

provenance.quote: The conference_participant field in the Voice Insights Call Summary is being removed from the REST API and Event Streams August 1, 2026.
The conference_participant attribute was removed on August 1, 2026; attributes now returns null.
